title: Toto
overview: Toto follows the emotional journey of a little brown stray dog who was once adored but now struggles to survive alone on the streets. Rejected and heartbroken, he finds solace watching puppies in a pet shop longing for love again. One rainy evening, a kind woman rescues him, giving him shelter and hope. At the shelter, Toto's life changes forever when a young boy named Max chooses him. Together, they form an unbreakable band -reminding us that love isn't something you buy... it's something you find.
